summary.text: Brad Barnhill is the Independent American Party candidate for Secretary of State. A Navy veteran and paralegal, he campaigns as "your independent voice" on voter ID rollout, voter-roll maintenance and repealing the Commerce Tax.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Navy; earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Virginia in 1981; has worked as a paralegal.
Has chaired the Clark County Central Committee of the Independent American Party and served as vice chairman of the state party.

sources.title: Elect Your Independent Voice for Nevada Secretary of State
